name: Saturation tabletop workshop
audience: Production engineering teams, incident commanders and facilitators
sourcePolicy: Shared corpus mechanisms transformed into a fictional scenario; no external research and no other experiment output
workflow: Identify incident mechanisms that test distinct skills
Create one fictional service and coherent hidden state
Stage evidence so local responses can alter the scenario
Define decision gates, observer rubric and debrief
Dry-run the timing and reveal order
goodEnoughDefinition: A facilitator can run the scenario in under two hours without inventing missing rules, participants must reason rather than guess, and the debrief measures graceful extensibility rather than trivia.
reviewChecks: Five staged injects form one coherent incident
No real organization is falsely described
